run_plot_voxels_shapes: run the plot_voxels CLI with --dataset shapes to visualize shape data in Visdom
run_plot_voxels_segments: run the plot_voxels CLI with --dataset segments to visualize segment data in Visdom
create_SchematicPlotter_drawMatplot: create a SchematicPlotter and call drawMatplot to render a 3D voxel schematic with matplotlib
create_SchematicPlotter_drawPlotly: create a SchematicPlotter and call drawPlotly to render a 3D voxel schematic as a scatter plot
create_cuboid_data: create cuboid vertex coordinate arrays for a given 3D position and size tuple
